card.name: Words after missing or odd grammar
card.fires_on: Ordinary words in garbled or ungrammatical web text, often a noun or adjective where an article, plural or other word was expected. Examples are 'sizes' after 'the' and 'injections' after 'for'.

modes.label: Plural noun after the
modes.description: A plural noun where a singular or different form would be expected.
modes.example: Minority influence can be affected by the<< sizes>> of majority and minority groups

modes.label: Word in broken phrase
modes.description: A word in a slightly wrong phrase, such as 'You may also interested'.
modes.example: You may also<< interested>> in: Encyclopedia of Mythology

modes.label: Label or list word
modes.description: A field word in a drug or reference listing.
